findingDetails.title: tieBreak insertion rule leaves the order among multiple new surfaces undefined
findingDetails.case: /create:skill-parent update --surfaces alpha,beta on a hub whose tieBreak already ends with surface gamma: both workflows+alpha+beta+gamma and workflows+beta+alpha+gamma satisfy the written rule
findingDetails.evidence: The added clause fixes only placement relative to pre-existing modes and never states the order among surfaces added in the same invocation; --surfaces accepts a comma-separated list and spec REQ-002 exercises only one stand-in surface.
findingDetails.userImpact: A keyword tie between two surfaces minted in one run can route to the wrong evidence base until noticed.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked single-surface-only limitation (none), multi-surface coverage in REQ-002 (none), and any second order clause in the four sites (none).
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Input order may be inferred from per-mode phrasing, but one-at-a-time reinsertion ahead of the previous new surface is equally compliant and reverses the order.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: An explicit order clause in all four sites, or a documented single-surface limit on --surfaces, would drop this to not-a-finding.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the order phrase to all four sites, e.g. when several surfaces are added in one run, in the order given.
